name: Shoulder guards
role: shoulders: a left and right pair of layered guards
what_i_did: A mirrored left and right pair. Each guard is 3 hemmed arches stacked down the arm: a cap and 2 lames, each a curved plate with a raised hem along both edges.
good: Two separate pieces, a true left and a true right, so each one follows its own arm.
The stack of three hemmed plates is there, and each plate is its own named part.
off: Outline match 0.67, the weakest of the six. The concept's guards are smooth rounded shells; mine read boxier, and the lames step down more steeply.
The concept shows the two guards identical; I mirrored them on purpose so each fits its own shoulder.
This one most needs another round: rounder arches and softer steps between the plates.
creative_additions: The deliberate left/right mirror, so the pair can go straight onto a rig.

rounds.t: First build: lames on the wrong side and the mirror inverted.
Rebuilt as arches along X with a proper left/right mirror; hems added.
Facet pass; final render and score.

score.method: silhouette IoU after bounding-box normalising both masks; camera found by grid search on the model, so a guide
